caption:
New Zealand's ruling coalition falls just short of majority in final count

Prime Minister Christopher Luxon needs the support of the centrist Opportunity Party to remain in power. Final election results showed on Friday that New Zealand's center-right coalition narrowly missed a parliamentary majority.

Reported by The Straits Times; BBC.
